intelligence.essence: He opened the fix-1d Hub himself: "it is better than it was, honestly" — but it goes back. The comment box, when it opens, must be a black obsidian box with white text; at rest it lights up white on the outside, when clicked it goes purple — right now it is white and pink inside, wrong. The four action buttons run right into the bar with no spacing — they need real gaps and breathing room. The board must fit into its frame better and sit solid on the black stage, not floating. The date and time must feel ACTIVE and working — alive, lit, visibly ticking; dates back to green like before, time stays gold, "yesterday" dropped, real dates only. The nutshell is still too much text — cap it at three or four sentences. RATE THE INTELLIGENCE — headline and icon dead center, the VALUE and INTELLIGENCE star bars centered in the intelligence block, lined up to the center of the page. The funny up/down button at the bottom right — the one that used to have the welcome — goes if it is a leftover with no desktop purpose. And the sidebar: closing it with the X works, but opening it again does nothing — both directions must work.
